A flowchart showing the relationship between agriculture and an agro-allied industry. On the left, a farmer harvesting yellow cocoa pods from a tree. An arrow points to the middle showing dried brown cocoa beans in a jute sack being transported by a truck. Another arrow points to the right showing a modern factory (beverage industry) producing tins of chocolate drink.

A split scene contrasting an undeveloped and a developed rural farming community. Left side (undeveloped): a muddy, impassable bush path, farmers carrying heavy baskets of yam on their heads, dim lighting. Right side (developed through agriculture): a smooth, graded asphalt feeder road, a small truck carrying neat crates of produce, a modern storage silo in the background, and electric poles lining the road.
